name: Proxy Cloud
summary: Flutter VPN client for Android, Windows, macOS and Linux with V2Ray connections and Telegram MTProto proxies.
description: Proxy Cloud is a Flutter desktop and mobile VPN client that connects through V2Ray/Xray subscriptions and Telegram MTProto proxies, with server selection, ping testing, auto-select, per-app tunneling and a subscription manager. It ships a dark Material 3 interface with bottom navigation in 8+ languages, plus tools for IP info, host checking and speed tests.
contains: V2Ray/Xray subscription connect with one-tap, ping test and auto-select
Telegram MTProto proxy list with country, provider, ping and uptime
tools: IP info, host checker, speed test, subscription store
releases for Android, Windows, macOS and Linux (deb, rpm, AppImage, AUR)
8+ languages; dark Material 3 UI with bottom navigation
MIT licensed and free, no subscriptions
